messages.text: Monday, October 12 · Canton, Michigan
Foggy morning yields to warm autumn day

A foggy start to the day will give way to warm, clear conditions. The most notable local development is the announcement of a lawsuit concerning inmate privacy, while researchers highlight climbing stroke rates in younger adults.
Expect fog this morning, clearing to a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F, with a negligible chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:43 AM, sunset at 6:57 PM, with the new moon 2.8% illuminated.
Local and area happenings
Consider attending the Alash performance at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM for a unique blend of Tuvan throat singing and traditional instruments.
Pop's Birthday is today, October 12th.
Lawsuit filed over inmate privacy during childbirth

A lawsuit filed today alleges that Michigan Department of Corrections officers recorded an inmate during labor, delivery, and postpartum care at an Ann Arbor hospital in March 2025. The complaint claims officers violated privacy policies.
Looking ahead to the week
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak on October 21st. A solar eclipse is predicted in 117 days.

Tuesday, October 13 · Canton, Michigan
Drizzle and Destiny: Orchestra Meets Space Research
A day of light drizzle greets Canton, with a high near 85°F. Today's highlights include a University Symphony Orchestra performance and new research on AI's role in ecological data collection.
Expect light drizzle today with a high near 85°F and a low around 64°F; the chance of precipitation is 14%.
Sunrise is at 7:45 AM and sunset is at 6:55 PM, with a waxing crescent moon 7.0% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's Afternoon and Evening Offerings

The University Symphony Orchestra performs at Hill Auditorium at 8 PM, offering a free program of Verdi and Tchaikovsky. Earlier, at 5 PM, the "String of Stories" workshop at 20 S. Thayer explores African history through beads and storytelling.
Tomorrow evening at 6:30 PM, there is an "862 Meeting" scheduled.
Michigan Auto Insurance Fees and Tribal Journeys

Michigan drivers will see lower fees for catastrophic auto insurance coverage due to reforms, with a $63 pure premium charge announced. Additionally, two Michigan tribes completed a 130-mile kayak voyage along Lake Michigan to reaffirm ancestral friendship.
Looking Ahead: Science and Spacecraft
Tomorrow, the "862 Meeting" is scheduled for 6:30 PM. Upcoming science news includes research on AI aiding ecology and NASA's SpaceX CRS-35 mission launching health experiments.
